blind.B1: Yes, as an in-vitro exercise-mediator design: HB9::GFP mESC motor neuron spheroids treated with conditioned medium from optogenetically exercised C2C12 (grp EX = High intensity biochem) or spontaneously twitching C2C12 (SP = Low intensity biochem) vs control medium (C). Biochem samples C1-6, LI1-6, HI1-6 (S2.4.p1-p3, FIG7a).
blind.B2: Exercise/Control, Spontaneous/Control, Exercise/Spontaneous (FIG7c-e). Paper n after QC: control 5, spontaneous 4, exercise 4 (FIG7a legend). The mechanical arm (M, MC) is a separate experiment (FIG7i).
blind.B3: No repeated measures: independent spheroid wells; no animal or person unit. Packet A candidate key (suffix of key) has 4 duplicates in a level and links only 6/26 samples; it is a replicate number, not an animal ID.

blind.B5: Paper: DEGs from DESeq2 with Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p (FIG7 legend; S4.10.p1: raw and BH-adjusted p reported, normal prior and ashr); no numeric cutoff or fold-change rule stated. Counts: 194 DEGs across the three biochemical comparisons (S2.4.p3, union); mechanical: 2 significant hits, both up (S2.4.p4). FIG7j heatmap uses nominal p for the top 50 genes.
